changes.to: Maker site (Sunrising AI / 光象科技, Tsinghua-incubated, founded 2025-04; released Phi-Bot X1 on 2026-06-10): 27 whole-body DOF with 1 kHz whole-joint control, 6 kg single-arm payload, 0-2.5 m working range, four-swerve-wheel omnidirectional chassis with active steering, crab and diagonal motion and in-place turning, 10 mm positioning and 0.05 mm end-effector repeatability, perception with 3 LiDAR, 3 RGBD (up to 5), 1 binocular camera and 8 ultrasonic radars, dual batteries with 1-minute hot-swap, quick-change end effectors. Height, weight, speed, battery capacity and runtime are not published. Maker reports real line deployment at premium car makers (welding load/unload, mobile inspection) and ISO 9001/45001/14001 certification from TUV Rheinland.
Sunrising AI's Phi-Bot X1 is an industrial self-evolving embodied robot on a four-swerve-wheel chassis, with 27 DOF, 6 kg per arm and a 0-2.5 m working range for loading, inspection and sorting.
